_meta.description: GitHub Engineering Signal Pack UI labels for opportunity cards
_meta.note: Loaded per request; no restart required when editing label copy.
_meta.compliance_note: Agent surfaces engineering signals to engineering leads only. No automated merge approvals, branch deletions, or code changes.

GITHUB_PR_REVIEW_BOTTLENECK.s6_why: Pull requests are waiting significantly longer than your review threshold, creating a downstream delivery bottleneck that compounds with each sprint.
GITHUB_PR_REVIEW_BOTTLENECK.s6_action: An agent can monitor open PR age daily, alert reviewers when PRs approach the threshold, and surface the oldest PRs to engineering leads automatically. No automated merge approvals — all merge decisions remain with the engineering team.

GITHUB_COMMIT_CONCENTRATION.s6_why: A single contributor is responsible for the majority of recent commits, creating a significant bus factor risk in this codebase.
GITHUB_COMMIT_CONCENTRATION.s6_action: An agent can track contribution distribution weekly, alert engineering leads when concentration exceeds threshold, and flag high-concentration areas for knowledge transfer planning. No automated code changes — all code decisions remain with the engineering team.

GITHUB_STALE_BRANCHES.s6_why: Stale branches are accumulating, indicating incomplete work, abandoned features, or process gaps in branch lifecycle management.
GITHUB_STALE_BRANCHES.s6_action: An agent can identify stale branches weekly, notify branch owners, and generate a cleanup report for engineering leads. No automated branch deletions — all branch lifecycle decisions remain with the engineering team.
